lint.observation: golangci-lint cannot run due to Go version mismatch: binary built with go1.25.4 but project targets go1.26.1. This is a pre-existing environment issue documented in .factory/library/environment.md. No code issues — the lint tool simply cannot load the config. The worker updated the golangci-lint binary via `go install` but the PATH still resolves to the old binary at /Users/joshka/.local/bin/golangci-lint. Non-blocking for this milestone.

nonBlockingIssues.description: Custom `asErr` helper in gateway.go should use `errors.As` for wrapped error handling consistency
errCh channels in startDev/startTsnet not formally closed by producer goroutines on happy shutdown path
PTY.Close() could add SIGKILL fallback if cmd.Wait() blocks after SIGTERM
JSON text messages that aren't recognized control types are written to PTY as raw input
Connection limit check happens after WebSocket upgrade (429 sent via WS rather than HTTP status code)
Origin allowlist includes broad '*.tail*' wildcard pattern
getOrCreatePTY holds room.mu lock during tmux spawn (serializes PTY creation)
xterm.js and FitAddon are placeholder stubs, not real npm assets
SSH exec requests rejected silently (no error message to client)
Room-not-found during SSH handshake gives no feedback to client (connection just closes)
MaxSessions default (10) documentation could clarify why 10 was chosen vs 'unlimited'

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add note that HTTP error responses from gateway handlers (web terminal, SSH) should use canonical JSON envelope format (version, status, command, data, meta, error) for consistency. The web terminal's writeErrorJSON currently omits version, status, command, and meta.ts fields.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: gateway-web-terminal review: internal/gateway/webterm/handler.go:195-211 outputs simplified error structure without envelope fields
